text: The reload/focus bar MAXIMUM is a hard-coded constant, not a SPEED formula, and it DIVERGES between builds: 5*24 = 120 on Android v0.682 and 8*24 = 192 on web v0.717. quote: §1t1540s0§.as:271-273 `var _loc2_:int = 800; var _loc3_:int = 480; var _loc4_:int = 690;` ; :304-305 `_loc8_ = §1t9973s0§.stageHeight / _loc3_; _loc9_ = (§1t9973s0§.stageWidth - _loc2_ * _loc8_) / 2;` ; :309 `§1t1523s0§.§1t9358s0§ = _loc8_;` ; §1t1523s0§.as:104 `public static var stageWidth:int = 800;` :106 `public static var stageHeight:int = 480;`
text: EVERY 'stage px' NUMBER IN docs/research/fidelity/COMBAT_MEASUREMENTS.md THAT WAS CONVERTED AT /1.875 IS 20% TOO LARGE. The correct 1080p divisor is 2.25. The web build's letterbox routine sets base 800x480 and, for a viewport wider than 800/480 = 1.6667, takes the fit-height branch: scale = stageHeight/480 and offsetX = (stageWidth - 800*scale)/2. At 1920x1080 that is scale 2.25 with 60 px pillarbox bars. Three independent confirmations: (1) source, §1t1540s0§.as:271-307 plus §1t1523s0§.as:104/106 (stageWidth 800, stageHeight 480); (2) frames -- I measured the pillarbox on four session11 frames (first/last column with any pixel >12): damage-ttk/t125.350.png 54->1862, gap-focus-trigger/t1747.000.png 48->1867, stance-reach/B_t783.400_LIGHT_stroke-anchored-at-body_farGap436px.png 52->1868, stance-reach/A_t117.400_BALANCED_lvl1_stroke235px.png 54->1863, i.e. content ~1810-1820 px = 800x2.25 = 1800 plus compression bleed, whereas /1.875 demands 210 px black bars that are simply not present; (3) reductio -- the HUD reload bar sits at row y=1036 (I measured it), which at /1.875 maps to stage y ~504, off the bottom of a 480-tall stage, physically impossible, while at /2.25 it maps to stage y ~460 of 480, i.e. the bottom HUD strip. Corrected c-2 reach bands: LIGHT 233-241 -> 194-201 (max 303 -> 252); BALANCED 116-131 -> 97-109; HEAVY 97-103 -> 81-86 (max 121 -> 101). Note the corrected Heavy MAX of 101 now kisses the source's hard 100-px floor, and every band sits at or below its source cap, which is what a body-to-endpoint distance should do against a path-length budget.
